import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
SEQ=""
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
print("=== Signal peptide architecture of Q13790 (UniProt Signal 1-35, ECO:0000255 only) ===")
print("n-region  1-16 :", SEQ[0:16],  " net charge", sum(1 for a in SEQ[0:16] if a in 'KR')-sum(1 for a in SEQ[0:16] if a in 'DE'))
print("h-region 17-32 :", SEQ[16:32], " mean Kyte-Doolittle %.2f"%np.mean([KD[a] for a in SEQ[16:32]]))
print("c-region 33-35 :", SEQ[32:35], " (-3,-2,-1 = %s,%s,%s)"%(SEQ[32],SEQ[33],SEQ[34]))
print("+1,+2,+3      :", SEQ[35:38])
# von Heijne -3/-1 rule: small residue required at -1 and -3
small=set('AGSTCV')
print("\nAlternative cleavage sites satisfying the -3/-1 small-residue rule within residues 20-45:")
for c in range(20,46):  # cleavage after residue c
    m1,m3=SEQ[c-1],SEQ[c-3]
    if m1 in 'AGSC' and m3 in small:
        h=np.mean([KD[a] for a in SEQ[max(0,c-18):c-6]])
        print(f"   cleave after {c:2d} ({SEQ[c-4:c]}|{SEQ[c:c+3]})  -1={m1} -3={m3}  upstream h-region KD={h:+.2f}")
print("\nNote: SignalP/NetNGlyc/NetOGlyc web servers were not reachable programmatically from this environment;")
print("the above is a hand-implemented von Heijne -3/-1 check, not a SignalP score.")

# Hydrophobicity profile figure for the signal region
w=9; prof=[np.mean([KD[a] for a in SEQ[i:i+w]]) for i in range(60-w)]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,3.2))
ax.plot(range(w//2+1,60-w+w//2+1),prof,color='#2a6f97')
ax.axhline(1.6,ls='--',c='r',lw=1); ax.axvline(35.5,c='k',lw=1.5)
ax.text(36,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.85,'UniProt signal\ncleavage 35|36',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (9 aa)")
ax.set_title("Q13790 N-terminal hydrophobicity: a single h-region consistent with one signal peptide")
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
